hero.eyebrow: Vilanova i la Geltrú · Plaça Soler i Carbonell
hero.title: Market cooking, made fresh each day
hero.subtitle: A restaurant on the square where the menu follows whatever reaches the market. Honest cooking, generous portions and the kind of service that brings you back.
hero.point1: Daily set menu built on market produce

about.title: A proper eating house on the square
about.lead: La Bien Pagá is a market-kitchen restaurant on Plaça Soler i Carbonell, in the centre of Vilanova. The set lunch is the heart of it: written each morning from what the market has.
about.body1: The cooking is direct and unfussy: fresh produce, classic preparations and portions built for sharing. The midday menu — starter, main, dessert and a drink — is what brings the neighbourhood in every day.
about.body2: The dining room is warm and family-run, and in summer the tables spill onto the square. It works for a work lunch as well as a long family afternoon.

reviews.title: What guests say after eating here
reviews.lead: Extracts from reviews published on Google by guests of the restaurant.

r1.text: Loved it! Three courses for €14.99, amazing value. Tasty, great quality and very friendly service.
r1.author: John Prendergast

r2.text: The food was delicious, but what made the experience special was the staff: incredibly kind, attentive and welcoming. A lovely atmosphere — I'd happily come back.
r2.author: Mohamed Taha

r3.text: If you want typical food from the area, this is a great choice. The owners are wonderful, both in how they treat you and in the quality of the dishes. Better to book ahead.
r3.author: sitgesgaymenchorus

r4.text: The food is amazing, one of the best I've tried in the area. The menu is very good value.
r4.author: Analia Mendonça
